tha-ap451:3.2: pakkhandanto → G. pakkhananto; S2 pakkhanta no. (pts note)
tha-ap451:4.2: byamhaṁ → vyambhaṁ (bj) | vyamhaṁ → G. brahmaṁ. (pts note)
